messages:
Olga: Heads-up — promote to prod blocked, deploy-bot aborted canary.
deploy-bot: Promotion aborted: CI job `canary-integrations` failed (exit=1). Logs: https://ci.redwood/job/1748456780 :warning:
Olga: Quick excerpt: `ERROR: cache: marshal failed: unsupported field type: *proto.ArtifactBlob` and `artifact-store: finalize part 2/4 checksum mismatch`.
Mateo: Repro locally with `redwood/builder:edge-2026-03-23`. Works with `redwood/builder:2026-02-28-stable`.
Rina: That smells like a protobuf-gen bump / cache schema drift — which PR landed? @Mateo
Mateo: PR #944 bumped protobuf generation and updated cache metadata version. It passed unit tests but integration is failing.
Ben: We have a 90m change window in ~1h. Options: pin the promo runner to the last-good builder image (keep release) or rollback the proto bump (delay).
Rina: Pinning is lower impact. We'll need a tracked follow-up to run a compatibility matrix and re-run the canary once fixed.
Olga: Agree pin + add a one-time canary retry policy to the pipeline to reduce manual unblocks.
Mateo: I'll open a small MR to pin `redwood/builder:2026-02-28-stable` in the promo job and trigger a rerun. ETA 18m.
deploy-bot: Manual retrigger requested by Mateo — job queued: https://ci.redwood/queue/1748456780 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
release: Please add a release-note line: "Promotion pinned to previous builder image due to artifact cache serialization issue; verification pending." Mark `requires-followup`.
oncall-bot: Incident CI_UPLOAD_1748456780 created and acknowledged. Escalate if unresolved in 45m.
Mateo: MR posted: https://git.redwood/infra/ci/-/merge_requests/459 — canary rerun started.
deploy-bot: Canary rerun in progress, step `artifact-upload` running.
Ben: If rerun passes we promote and schedule post-release compatibility canary + ticket to reconcile proto-gen. If it fails we reconvene and consider delaying the window.
Olga: Executing pin path for now. Will update thread with pass/fail. :thumbsup:
